summary_en: # Wearable Bone Conduction Hearing Aid / Headphone PCB Wearable bone-conduction hearing aid headphone PCB based on the ESP32-S3, integrating an I2S MEMS microphone input, I2S audio amplifier output, LiPo battery charging, USB-C power/programming support, and a bone-conduction transducer interface. This project focused on end-to-end wearable audio hardware development, including BOM creation, schematic design, PCB layout, and board assembly through JLCPCB. ## Key Features - Wearable headphone / hearing aid form factor - ESP32-S3-based embedded audio platform - I2S MEMS microphone input for audio capture - I2S DAC/amplifier output for driving a bone-conduction transducer - 3.7V battery-powered design ## Hardware Architecture The board is centered around the ESP32-S3 microcontroller and integrates audio input, audio output, battery charging, power regulation, and programming/debug circuitry into a compact wearable PCB. - **MCU:** ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 - **Microphone input:** I2S MEMS microphone for audio capture - **Audio output:** I2S DAC/amplifier for driving the bone-conduction transducer - **Transducer interface:** 2-pin connector for bone-conduction transducer output - **Power:** 3.7

summary: WearEars 是 Wear OS 3+ 手表端的跨品牌 TWS 控制应用。手表通过蓝牙按各品牌逆向出的私有协议向耳机发送指令并回读状态，实现降噪、关闭、通透三态切换，显示左耳、右耳与充电盒电量及充电状态，耳机通常仍与手机保持音频连接。应用提供磁贴快捷控制、表冠/表圈滚动交互与多种界面风格，并以驱动注册表加填空骨架，让用户把协议资料交给 AI 生成新品牌驱动。
summary_en: # WearEars 🎧⌚ > 项目原名 `tws-control-for-wear`，2026-10 起更名为 **WearEars**；旧的仓库链接会自动跳转到新地址。 [ ](https://github.com/hdzw1155/WearEars/releases) [ ](https://github.com/hdzw1155/WearEars/blob/main/LICENSE) > ⚠️ **AI 风险警告**：本项目深度依赖 AI 生成代码与逆向的私有蓝牙协议，AI 可能给出错误指令——**存在不可挽回地损坏你的耳机、手表或其他设备，以及造成听力损伤、数据丢失的风险**。实验性操作前请务必摘下耳机并调低音量，详见下方免责声明。 **我们的目标是：让 Wear OS 手表用户都能跨品牌控制、适配自己的 TWS 蓝牙耳机。** 不用羡慕原厂全家桶生态——在 **Wear OS 3+ 手表**（如三星 Galaxy Watch 等）上，你可以**不依赖手机**，通过蓝牙切换耳机的降噪/通透模式、查看左/右耳与充电盒电量；耳机通常还能同时保持与手机的正常音频连接。 更进一步，这是一个**为 AI 自由适配而生**的开源项目：哪怕你完全不会写代码，也可以尝试把本页面和手头耳机的开源协议资料一并丢给 AI，让它照着项目内置的填空骨架帮你生成专属耳机驱动——**欢迎所有人 Fork、魔改、适配你自己的耳机！** > 💡 **项目背景与三不原则**：本项目是单品牌前作 [vivo-tws-watch-control](https://github.com/hdzw1155/vivo-tws-watch-control) 的多品牌重构版。**个人免费开源、不收集不上传任何数据、严禁任何形式的商业倒卖**（禁止在闲鱼/淘宝/付费群等打包收费或付费代装）。 ## 📊 当前支持情况与核心功能 * **手表端**：实测三星 Galaxy Watch7（Wear OS），其他 **Wear OS 3+** 手表理论通用。 * **核心功能**： * **降噪三态切换**：降噪 / 关闭 / 通透三档一键切换（当前模式高亮显示）。 * **三端电量显示**：实时显示左耳、右耳、充电盒电量及充电状态。 * **省心连接体验**：断线状态自动清空、回到前台自动重连；适配手表旋转表圈/实体表冠——转动时绵密分段震动、顶到边界有一下明显的挡墙反馈；屏幕右缘滚动指示条上下双拼色，滚动时带 Q 弹阻尼回弹。 * **磁贴快捷控制**：不用打开 App，在手表磁贴里就能切降噪模式，顺便看一眼上一次连接的电量；三段电量与整机总电量（单电池设备）自适应显示，磁贴样式可跟随界面或单独指定。 * **三种界面风格 + 设置页**：极简（横向进度条）/ 液位（胶囊块）/ 经典（压扁圆环）三种电

summary: EncoDeck 是用 WinUI 3 编写的 Windows 桌面耳机控制工具。程序通过蓝牙向耳机发送控制命令并回读确认：显示左右耳与充电盒电量及充电状态，切换降噪、通透、关闭、自适应及降噪强度，调整 EQ、空间音频、BassWave，并管理耳机触控；可只留托盘图标操作，也支持全局快捷键。以 OPPO/一加为主要适配对象，同时兼容多品牌头戴与 TWS 及 USB 2.4G 游戏耳机，不同型号可用设置不同。
summary_en: EncoDeck 在 Windows 上轻松管理你的耳机，不用为了切个降噪再拿起手机。 下载安装包 · English · 设备兼容性 · 开发文档 > 🍎 **Mac 用户**推荐使用 [HeyBuds](https://github.com/abaichuan1017/HeyBuds)。 EncoDeck 是用 **WinUI 3** 编写的 Windows 耳机控制工具。它把常用的耳机设置搬到了电脑上：查看左右耳和充电盒电量、切换降噪、调整 EQ 和空间音频，以及管理耳机触控等功能。平时可以只留一个托盘图标，不需要一直开着主窗口。 目前以 **OPPO / 一加** 耳机为主要适配对象，也支持部分 **realme / DIZO、vivo / iQOO、华为、荣耀、小米 / Redmi、索尼、AKG、森海塞尔、漫步者、水月雨 MOONDROP、三星、Google、Bose、Nothing / CMF** 耳机及 USB 2.4G 游戏耳机。不同型号可用的设置不一样；**目前主要使用 OPPO Enco X4 进行真机验证**，其他型号主要依据协议和型号配置实现，欢迎反馈测试结果。 ## 界面 | 主界面 | 托盘快捷面板 | | :---: | :---: | | | | ## 功能 ### 电量与连接状态 连接耳机后，主界面和托盘面板会显示设备返回的电量；真无线耳机按支持情况显示左耳、右耳和充电盒，头戴式显示单组电量。充电状态、佩戴、入盒状态和固件版本取决于型号。 充电盒离开耳机后通常不会继续上报电量，因此 EncoDeck 会保留最近一次读数，并标明是「上次读取」，而不是把旧数据当作实时电量。电量过低时还会提醒。 ### 降噪控制 不用打开主窗口，在托盘就能切换： - **降噪 / 通透 / 关闭 / 自适应**（具体取决于耳机型号）； - 降噪强度：**深度、中度、轻度、智能切换**； - 自适应模式下的降噪偏好（耳机支持时）。 用耳机手势或者手机调整了降噪，EncoDeck 也会读取耳机上报的状态并更新界面。控制命令通过蓝牙发送，等待耳机确认并回读；失败时不会把按钮一直停留在错误状态。 还可以在「设置 → 快捷键」中绑定全局快捷键，比如一键在降噪和通透之间切换，或者直接切到指定模式。全屏游戏时同样可以使用。 ### 音效 音效选项按照耳机的型号配置和实际能力显示。 | 设置 | 可以做什么 | | --- | --- | | **EQ** | 切换耳机内置的音效预设，如丹拿相关预设、人声、高音、低音等（名称因型号而异） | | **自定义 EQ** | 在支持的 OPPO 型号上编辑、保存、切换和删除 EQ；Enco X4 对应最多 3 组、每组 10 段 | | **BassWave** | 开关动态低音并调整强度 | | **空间音频**

summary_en: # WaveTune **English** | [简体中文](README_zh.md) An unofficial multi-brand wireless headset control center for the Linux desktop (ported from [EncoDeck](https://github.com/TIANLI0/EncoDeck)), built with Rust and GTK4 / Libadwaita. It currently supports OPPO, OnePlus, realme, and EarFun wireless headsets, with a decoupled multi-brand architecture ready for expanding to additional brands in the future. > This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by any headset vendor. See [`docs/api/OPPO_BLUETOOTH_API.md`](docs/api/OPPO_BLUETOOTH_API.md) and [`docs/api/EARFUN_BLUETOOTH_API.md`](docs/api/EARFUN_BLUETOOTH_API.md) for private Bluetooth protocol details and hardware verification notes. ## Features - **Status Monitoring & 3D Preview**: Real-time battery levels and charging status for left/right earbuds and charging case, in-ear wear and case-lid detection, firmware version display, device artwork, and interactive 3D model preview. - **Noise Control**: Switch between Active Noise Cancellation (with multi-level intensity), Transparency mode (including Vocal Enhancement), and Adaptive noise control. - **Sound & Audio Effects**: Built-in sound presets, custom multi-band Equalizer (EQ), Sp

summary: TWS PoP 是 Android 端的耳机连接弹窗应用。当受支持的耳机与手机连接时，应用识别耳机型号，并弹出与该设备对应的视觉内容：设备专属图稿、浮动动画或专属视频；未收录的机型则回落到默认弹窗。它把系统原本单一的连接提示做成按型号定制的个性化体验，目前已明确收录 boAt Airdopes 219、OnePlus Nord Buds 与 Sony WH-CH720N 等设备。
summary_en: Smart Earbud Popups for Android TWS PoP Smart Earbud Popups for Android A device-aware popup experience for headphones and earbuds. [ ](https://github.com/LensKnight/tws-pop/releases) --- # TWS PoP **A device-aware popup experience for headphones and earbuds on Android.** TWS PoP is an Android application designed to provide a personalized popup experience when supported headphones and earbuds connect. It combines device-specific artwork, floating animations, and custom video playback. --- ## Overview TWS PoP makes connecting headphones and earbuds more personalized through dedicated visuals and device-specific popup experiences. ## Features - **Device Detection** — Identifies supported headphone and earbud models. - **Custom Visuals** — Displays device-specific artwork. - **Floating Animations** — Adds subtle motion to device artwork. - **Video Playback** — Supports dedicated popup videos for selected devices. - **Default Experience** — Provides a fallback popup for other devices. ## Supported Devices | Device | Popup Experience | |---|---| | boAt Airdopes 219 | Custom video | | OnePlus Nord Buds | Dedicated video | | Sony WH-CH720N | Headphone artwork | | Other devices | Default

summary_en: # vivo TWS Watch Control [ ](https://github.com/hdzw1155/vivo-tws-watch-control/releases) [ ](https://github.com/hdzw1155/vivo-tws-watch-control/blob/main/LICENSE) 在 **Wear OS 手表**上直接控制 **vivo / iQOO TWS 耳机**的降噪模式与电量查询——不依赖手机，手表通过经典蓝牙 RFCOMM 直连耳机发送 vivo 私有 GAIA 指令。耳机可同时保持与手机的音频连接（双设备连接）。 - **个人免费开源**，与 vivo 官方无关 - **零数据收集**：不收集、不上传任何数据，无网络权限 - **按"现状"提供**：兼容性可能随耳机固件更新而变化 - **严禁商业倒卖**：仅供非商业学习交流，禁止打包收费或在闲鱼/淘宝等平台售卖 > ⚠️ **非官方、未获授权**：本项目为非商业个人学习研究作品，未获 vivo / 三星 / 高通 / 蓝牙技术联盟任何授权与关联认证；文中出现的第三方商标仅作兼容性说明（名义性合理使用），归各自所有者所有。协议基于开源社区公开逆向成果（见致谢），由作者借助 AI 辅助完成 Wear OS 端开发与实机调试。 ## ✨ 功能 - **噪声控制三选一**：降噪开 / 降噪关 / 通透，当前模式高亮（适配圆形表盘的深色卡片式 UI） - **系统卡片（磁贴）**：表盘滑页即达——连接状态 + 三个电量环 + 降噪三档直切 + 打开控制入口，数据变化自动刷新 - **三段电量显示**：左耳 / 右耳 / 充电盒百分比 + 彩色进度条（绿正常、红低电量、⚡️充电中、`--` 未上报） - **DeepX 音效五档**（开发者设置）：标准 / 清澈人声 / 超重低音 / 清亮高音 / 悠扬听书循环切换；前三档真机验证，后两档按官方顺序推断 - **空间音频开关**（开发者设置·实验性）：作者感觉无效，请勿依赖；指令链路已打通（首次启用弹独立风险确认框，记住后不再打扰），仅限 vivo TWS Air 3 Pro；开发者设置默认隐藏，每次启动重新关闭，连点 5 下"开发者设置"入口开启 - **智能连接与省电**：切后台自动断开省电，回前台自动重连；耳机断开（开关机/超距）时电量显示自动清空并自动重连恢复，页面内也可手动刷新 - **首次启动安全确认**：每个新版本首次打开都需阅读并确认免责与佩戴安全提示（同版本只确认一次） ## 📱 支持的手表 - **实测机型**：三星 Galaxy Watch7（SM-L300，Wear OS / Android 16）——本项目在这台手表上完成实机验证 - **其他 Wear OS 手表**：满足 Wear

summary_en: # QuickBuds **An alternative to HeyMelody and realme Link for your OnePlus, OPPO and realme earbuds.** Android · Windows · Linux [ ](./LICENSE) [ ](#install) [ ](https://github.com/spizganed/QuickBuds/releases/latest) [ ](https://ko-fi.com/spizganed) [ ](https://discord.gg/pvsnEf9TrZ) QuickBuds is an open-source alternative to HeyMelody and realme Link. It talks to your earbuds over Bluetooth. It shows the controls that your model has. The phone has real home screen widgets. The PC has a tray icon. It is a hobby project. You can support it on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/spizganed). ## Supported earbuds QuickBuds works on **any Android 8+ phone** (Samsung, Google Pixel, Xiaomi, Nothing, Motorola, OnePlus…), not only on OnePlus / OPPO phones. It knows every model in HeyMelody's and realme Link's lists: 140 models in 143 entries. Three models have two ids. It shows only the features each model has. Each model also lists its known issues in Settings. On OnePlus, OPPO and realme phones (OxygenOS 12 and later, ColorOS, realme UI), the system's own earbud settings can hold the control link of the earbuds. QuickBuds cannot connect in that case. Use the earbud settings in Settings › Bluetoot

Older versions used wires to transfer sound data, but newer versions use a wireless communication. Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) is the used wireless communication. It is really suitable for sound streaming. From an electronic engineer's view, it is really hard to design a small, low power and battery operated device which can be used inside ears. It has lots of challenges. This project is a guide for ones who want to know the basics of Earbuds. #### Design Features - Bluetooth Low Energy - Low power, battery operated device - Chip antenna - Matching network design - MEMS sensors - Audio codecs ICs - Audio power amplifier - Power IC management - Battery charging through Power Line Communication (PLC) #### Featured Applications - Earbuds - Hearable - Audio streaming - Voice Recognition #### Block Diagram Fig.1 shows the overall view of the design. summary_en: # asha-windows > **The first open-source attempt at implementing ASHA (Audio Streaming for Hearing Aids) on Windows using Python.** [ ](https://www.python.org/) [ ](https://www.microsoft.com/windows) [ ](https://source.android.com/docs/core/connect/bluetooth/asha) [ ]() --- ## What is ASHA? **ASHA (Audio Streaming for Hearing Aids)** is a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) protocol developed by Google that allows hearing aids to receive audio directly from a device. summary_en: ### open-earable-PlatformIO The easiest way to compile and deploy the OpenEarable firmware is this [PlatformIO](https://platformio.org) wrapper firmware. Before you start, please make sure you have setup [PlatformIO for VSCode](https://platformio.org/install/ide?install=vscode). You can then open this project to compile and deploy the OpenEarable firmware. It will be controllable via our [Dashboard](https://github.com/OpenEarable/dashboard), via [edge-ml](https://edge-ml.org/), and the BLE API. > [!IMPORTANT] > Due to a bug in PlatformIO, [flashing the firmware with a platform version of 9.6.0 or newer results in the OpenEarable to crash and disappear as a USB device](https://github.com/platformio/platform-nordicnrf52/issues/175). Please use a version of 9.5.0 or older to flash the firmware. You can achieve this by adding `platform = nordicnrf52@9.5.0` to the `platformio.ini` file.

summary_en: Current assistive hearing devices, such as hearing aids and cochlear implants, lack the ability to adapt to the listener's focus of auditory attention, limiting their effectiveness in complex acoustic environments like cocktail party scenarios where multiple conversations occur simultaneously. Neuro-steered hearing devices aim to overcome this limitation by decoding the listener's auditory attention from neural signals, such as electroencephalography (EEG). While many auditory attention decoding (AAD) studies have used high-density scalp EEG, such systems are impractical for daily use as they are bulky and uncomfortable. Therefore, AAD with wearable and unobtrusive EEG systems that are comfortable to wear and can be used for long-term recording are required. summary_en: Active noise cancellation (ANC) is common in headphones but rare in hearing aids, and its value for understanding speech in noise is not established. Algorithms that improve signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) act only on the hearing aid's amplified path, while unprocessed sound also reaches the eardrum directly through the vent, limiting the SNR improvement that is realized. Our earlier simulations predicted that attenuating this direct path with ANC would substantially increase the benefit of such processing. We tested that prediction in three hardware conditions: a standard receiver-in-canal (RIC) hearing aid, and an ANC-capable RIC with ANC off and on. Each was fit to NAL-NL2 targets for an N3 hearing loss and recorded on KEMAR with an AI speech-enhancement algorithm (AI-SE) off and on, in seven realistic scenes above 70 dB SPL. summary_en: The human ear offers a unique opportunity for cardiac monitoring due to its physiological and practical advantages. However, existing earable solutions require additional hardware and complex processing, posing challenges for commercial True Wireless Stereo (TWS) earbuds which are limited by their form factor and resources. In this paper, we propose TWSCardio, a novel system that repurposes the IMU sensors in TWS earbuds for cardiac monitoring. Our key finding is that these sensors can capture in-ear ballistocardiogram (BCG) signals. TWSCardio reuses the unstable Bluetooth channel to stream the IMU data to a smartphone for BCG processing. It incorporates a signal enhancement framework to address issues related to missing data and low sampling rate, while mitigating motion artifacts by fusing multi-axis information. However, the feasibility of detecting the relevant delta, theta, alpha, and beta band EEG activity through the ear EEG is yet to be investigated. Through measurements of scalp and ear EEG on ten subjects during a simulated, monotonous driving experiment, this study provides statistical analysis of characteristic ear EEG changes that are associated with the transition from alert to mentally fatigued states, and subsequent testing of a machine learning based automatic fatigue detection model. summary_en: Open-fit hearing aids have attracted growing attention due to their superior wearing comfort. However, the open-fit design inevitably causes acoustic leakage into the ear canal, degrading the performance of existing binaural speech enhancement (BSE). To this end, we propose ABSE-NET, an active BSE framework integrating active noise control (ANC) with BSE to jointly enhance target speech and suppress acoustic leakage. The ABSE-NET pipeline cascades a binaural MVDR (BMVDR) with a lightweight neural network (LNN). The former achieves a coarse BSE, whereas the latter simultaneously cancels acoustic leakage and compensates for BMVDR-induced distortion. The LNN uses an encoder-decoder with a feature fusion module, which includes frequency-time dependency learning and convolutional attention blocks. In contrast to traditional earphone antennas that rely on a conventional single-feed configuration, the proposed design introduces a dual-feed excitation technique incorporating a controlled phase difference between the two feeds. This innovative feeding strategy effectively enlarges the equivalent radiating aperture, thereby enhancing the overall radiation efficiency of the antenna system. summary_en: Interaction with sensor-augmented earphones, referred to as earables or hearables, represents a major area of earable research. Proximate to the head and reachable by hand, earables support diverse interactions and can detect multiple inputs simultaneously. Yet this diversity has fragmented research, complicating the tracking of developments. To address this, we introduce EarXplore, a curated, interactive online database on earable interaction research. summary_en: Whisphone is a novel earbud device designed for speech input via whispering. Utilizing canal-type earbuds with a unique microphone placement at the tip of the earplug, it effectively captures whispered voices radiated in the ear canal through bone conduction. This design can boost whispered voice volume with ear canal occlusion effect while simultaneously blocking external noise by sealing the ear hole. By incorporating Active Noise Canceling (ANC), Whisphone can effectively detect subtle whispers, even in noisy environments of up to 80dB(A). Its compact and comfortable design ensures discreet wearability, allowing users to interact with AI assistants hands-free without disturbing others in various daily situations such as offices, homes, or urban public spaces.

This iOS application leverages the glasses’ hands-free camera and microphone to provide seamless, distraction-free analysis, replacing tedious manual tracking with context-aware, first-person perspective (POV) data capture. The core purpose is to automatically log and analyze study sessions so the student can focus on learning. The system’s contextual AI passively analyzes each study session to continuously understand: Learning Content — the subject, subtopic, and key visible text from study materials Learning State — whether the student is actively engaged, passively reviewing, or distracted Students can also invoke a voice-based AI assistant for immediate, hands-free help, receiving guidance (not direct answers) without needing to touch their phone. Following each session, SmartSight presents a personalized learning dashboard that turns invisible effort into visible insight—showing metrics like time per topic, active vs. passive learning ratio, help count, and distraction count. summary_en: FurReact ears utilize face and eye tracking from the Samsung Galaxy XR headset to control motorized animal ears that twitch and move to reflect a user’s emotions depending on facial expressions. This project was borne from love and passion; as well as servos, microcontrollers and hot glue. Two MG90S servos and an ESP-32 microcontroller are mounted to a 3D printed headband. The ESP-32 is powered by a battery bank and then wirelessly communicates with the Samsung Galaxy XR using MIT Singularity VR/AR Unity SDK. The Galaxy then provides face tracking data which is sent to Unity, processed, and then turned into instructions for the servos. The whole device can be looped onto the arms of the headset and adjusted to fit via elastic Velcro. The biggest challenge was getting the many interconnecting physical and software elements to work together. MIT Singularity needed to be adapted to work with the Samsung Galaxy XR (the code adapted to work the device was posted to the reality hack discord). summary: Between Us 是一个把音乐、手部动作与脑电信号融合在一起的实时交互系统。它实时分析 WAV 音频的频率与振幅，用 Meta Quest 3 的手部追踪把手势与移动转成程序化声音，并从 MindRove 脑电头环采集信号、经 FFT 提取 alpha、beta、theta、gamma、delta 等频段。这些数据在 Unity 中驱动粒子系统与 VFX Graph，以颜色、大小和运动呈现音乐与专注、放松等状态，多人场景下还会展示参与者之间脑活动的同步。早期版本用过 Sonic Pi、MIDI 与 OSC，后为稳定性与性能整体迁到 Unity。
summary_en: Between Us is a real-time interactive system that combines music visualization, hand-tracking instrumentation, and EEG brain-computer interfaces. Audio, body movement, and brainwave data are transformed into dynamic particle systems, colors, and shapes in Unity. Users can create music through hand gestures, visualize WAV audio files, and see their brain activity—such as concentration and relaxation—represented visually. In multiplayer scenarios, the system also shows how brain activity can synchronize between participants. The project was built primarily in Unity, integrating multiple input and processing layers: WAV audio files are analyzed in real time to extract frequency and amplitude data. Hand tracking (Meta Quest 3 / Meta All In One SDK) is used to generate procedural sounds based on gestures and movement. EEG data from MindRove headsets is processed using FFT to extract brainwave bands (alpha, beta, theta, gamma, delta). Unity Particle Systems and VFX Graph are used to visualize music and brain activity through color, size, and motion. summary_en: Dream.ee is a VR-based exploratory platform that generates adaptive worlds to help users understand what genuinely engages them. Users enter immersive environments on Meta Quest and explore freely, without instructions or predefined goals. As users interact with the world, Dream.ee captures behavioral signals such as time spent on objects, repeated interactions, movement patterns, and exploration depth. These signals are analyzed in real time to infer what types of activities, challenges, and environments resonate with the user. Based on this, the system dynamically generates new worlds that better align with the user’s demonstrated interests. Dream.ee was built using Unity on Meta Quest 3 for the VR runtime, and the Brain Bit SDK2 for Unity for integration with the Brain Bit EEG sensor (which is a type of brain-computer interface). It used a lightweight FastAPI backend, and worlds were represented as structured WorldSpec JSON objects, which allows us to dynamically generate, load, and swap environments at runtime. summary_en: Our system lets users explore electric and magnetic fields in XR by grabbing and manipulating 3D physics objects . Inside a Meta Quest 3 headset, users use their controllers to hold and rotate virtual bar magnets and horseshoe magnets while seeing electromagnetic vector fields update in real time. As they move and re-orient the objects, the field lines, vectors, and particles respond dynamically in 3D space, building spatial intuition for how forces behave in the real world. Alongside this, we also designed and fabricated physical proxy objects that mirror the virtual ones, laying the groundwork for future fully tangible interaction. We built on MIT’s open-source vrmit backend in Godot, which provides real-time vector field computation and rendering. Our work focused on: Creating and integrating 3D magnet objects for XR interaction Implementing electric and magnetic field visualizations Designing intuitive grab-and-rotate interactions for learning Prototyping physical proxy objects and QR-tagged props for future tracking Our goal was to bridge physical objects and XR through QR-based tracking. The system focuses on four everyday needs: Recognizing important people Remembering daily tasks and moments Finding misplaced items Guiding the user back home Information appears only when it’s needed, keeping interactions calm and unobtrusive. For facial recognition, we deployed lightweight on-device computer vision models, enabling reliable performance while keeping user data private. summary_en: Rain With Me is a biometric empathy bridge that translates internal emotional states into an external shared reality between two people. The system captures real-time physiological data (Galvanic Skin Response and Heart Rate) and audiovisual cues from one user (the Sender) via the Google Gemini Live API. This data is processed through a custom sensor fusion engine to determine this user's arousal (intensity) and valence (positivity/negativity). This emotional state is instantly broadcast in two forms: Immersive AR Visualization : A dynamic weather system in Unity where rain intensity mirrors the Sender's stress levels. Haptic Feedback : When a second user (the Receiver) reaches out to "touch" the virtual rain, hand-tracking triggers vibration motors, allowing them to physically feel the volatility of their partner's emotions. We engineered a low-latency hub-and-spoke UDP architecture to synchronize hardware, AI inference, and AR visualization with under 50ms of latency. The Sensor Layer & Affective Computing We utilized the Circumplex Model of Affect to map emotion. summary: 四组件XR系统：患者戴Ray-Ban Meta眼镜，长按即拍摄第一视角画面，同时用Apple SFSpeechRecognizer做端上语音识别、用CoreLocation取GPS，经自建WebSocket把图像URL、转写与位置以JSON送往后端。后端以Gemini 2.0 Flash做多模态推理，并每20秒被动采集一次第一视角画面索引进自建RAG库，生成小时与日度摘要。回答通过开放式扬声器用AVSpeechSynthesizer朗读，并实时镜像到照护者看板，另有Meta Quest端参与同一工作流。属黑客松现场demo。
summary_en: OurLife : A Second Brain for Those Who Need It Most - Help people with memory loss live independently, with dignity, and stay connected to their lo... We built a 4-component XR system that connects Ray-Ban Meta glasses, a multi-modal AI backend, Meta Quest, and a caregiver dashboard into one coherent, human-centered workflow. Patient Device (Ray-Ban Meta Glasses) Meta Wearables SDK (DAT) – Uses MWDATCamera for H.264 video streaming and frame-level head-POV image capture. Multi-modal query capture – On user long-press, captures head-POV image, on-device STT via Apple SFSpeechRecognizer , and GPS coordinates via CoreLocation . WebSocket transport – Sends structured JSON payloads (image URL, transcript, location) to the backend using a custom WebSocket client. Voice UI output – AI responses are spoken aloud through open-ear speakers using AVSpeechSynthesizer , with live transcription mirrored in the caregiver app. Continuous passive context capture – Every 20 seconds, captures head-POV image and context, uploads to backend, and indexes into a custom RAG store; processed into hourly summaries and daily summaries. Backend (Google Cloud Platform) Gemini 2.0 Flash – Multi-modal reasoning

summary: 作品设定在 3026 年，是一款双人合作混合现实游戏。两名玩家分处两个世界：一人戴 Meta Quest 3 进入 XR，另一人在现实世界；两人围绕同一个实体飞船控制器相对而坐。现实侧玩家通过按键操作控制器，XR 侧玩家看到控制器的数字孪生，其背面展开为飞船内部的六个房间，每个房间叠加以文字描述 Ocan 在船上的记忆。六段记忆中三段为真实、三段为 Ocan 在压力下产生的类人幻觉。玩家需通过跨世界沟通交换信息，辨别哪些是真实记忆、哪些是幻觉，从而稳定濒临失控的飞船核心。项目为黑客松现场原型。
summary_en: Set in the year 3026, Ocan is a co-op mixed reality game where two players exist in two different realms—one in XR and one in the physical world. Through cross-realm communication, they must collaborate to stabilize a failing spaceship core threatened by an AI agent named Ocan spiraling into hallucinations that distort its own memories onboard the ship. The game explores the blurred boundary between Ocan’s memory, machine dreaming, and human-like cognition, asking the players to judge what is real and what is an illusion generated by Ocan’s under pressure. The core interaction of this game happens all within one physical object: the spaceship controller. Each player sits on either side of the controller to face the center. One player physically interacts with the controller through buttons and the other wears the Meta Quest 3 and sees a digital twin of the controller; its backside reveals the interior of the spaceship, divided into six distinct rooms. Each room displays an overlay with text describing Ocan’s memories of its time onboard the spaceship. summary: 这是一个 VR 原型：玩家站在舞台中央，四周环绕四座乐器塔。通过 Meta Quest 的手势追踪，玩家以少量简单手势施放法术球，并把法术球拖拽到乐器上，改变该乐器的音乐输出与攻击行为。被强化后的乐器会用声音与节奏驱动的效果自动攻击来袭敌人，使音乐同时成为武器与战斗逻辑。项目在 Unity 中开发，手势识别基于 Quest 手部追踪，并通过 Arduino 实现实时交互；音频系统与玩法逻辑紧耦合，声音变化直接反映为战斗行为变化。团队刻意收敛手势集合以保证识别可靠性，属于黑客松范围的可读原型。
summary_en: We built a VR prototype where the player stands at the center of a stage surrounded by four instrument towers. Using hand tracking, the player performs simple, intuitive gestures to cast spell orbs, which can be dragged onto instruments to modify their musical output and attack behavior. Once enhanced, instruments automatically attack incoming enemies using sound- and rhythm-driven effects, turning music into both a weapon. The project was built in Unity using Meta Quest hand tracking for gesture recognition and real-time interaction via Arduino. We focused on a small but readable gesture set to ensure reliability within a hackathon scope, mapping each gesture to a spell and musical effect. Audio systems were tightly coupled with gameplay logic so that changes in sound directly reflected changes in combat behavior, reinforcing music as a core mechanic. One of our biggest challenges was balancing expressive input with technical reliability—designing gestures that felt natural while still being consistently recognized by the hardware. summary_en: Reboot is a sci-fi horror experience - the player must survive one minute while an alien hunts them down! What makes our title unique is the controller - rather than using a virtual control panel, we constructed a physical controller that allows for a tactile, immersive experience. Our interface includes two panels of buttons and LEDs, as well as a large button, rotary encoder, and sliding lever. The panels are used to scan rooms and activate defense barriers. A heat buildup system punishes players for keeping too many systems on for too long. Additionally, the number of inputs to remember as the player attempts to locate and impede the enemy under pressure adds another layer of challenge. We combined Aruco tracking and mixed-reality passthrough to view the control panel in real time. As a result, the end product is intuitive to use. Finally, we opted for a run-down, cassette/retro-futuristic aesthetic inspired by similar media we enjoyed. Our design process began with planning: how did we want to generate suspense, what elements the player would interact with, etc. These elements were brainstormed on a chalkboard and then composed into a design document. On-Device Edge AI Classification The Arduino Uno Q processes the webcam feed with an Edge AI model running directly on the Arduino Uno Q. Exercise Classification The model classifies dumbbell curl exercises into several discrete form states (idle, back arch, elbow out, and perfect) XR Feedback Loop Classification results are streamed to a Samsung Galaxy XR headset, where: Visual cues highlight form issues A digital trainer avatar demonstrates the correct movement Users receive immediate, intuitive feedback We had a lot of false starts on this project. summary_en: Love, Hate and Robot is a mixed reality “dreaming machine” for everyday decisions. In Android XR, users draw a simple object associated with a daily dilemma (e.g., a cupcake temptation). Gemini Live recognises and spawns a 3D version, and gives it a voice and personality. Then two inner voices appear, an “angel” and a “devil”, brought to life through a Unitree humanoid robot that moves with emotion and attitude. In under two minutes, users experience an embodied debate and leave with a decision they can commit to. Unity + Android XR : Built the mixed reality experience where users draw and interact with objects in headset. Gemini Live : Used multimodal AI for sketch recognition, object generation, and real-time conversational improvisation. 3D object pipeline : Spawned a 3D “talking object” (e.g., cupcake) and gave it a personality-driven voice. Unitree humanoid robot : Embodied the “angel” and “devil” personas through expressive physical movement via HTTP bridge server within Unity for real-time call Interaction mapping : Routed user choices to persona dialogue + robot actions to create a fast, repeatable 2-minute demo loop. On device ML to object detection, 3D model re-generation

summary: 项目将原本用于机器人拳击与对打的 K1 Booster 人形机器人改造为具备模拟情绪感受与表达的存在，结合传感器、人形机器人运动学控制与对话式 AI，搭建真实场景供人练习冲突降级与共情沟通；XR 侧承载练习情境，用户尝试安抚这个“有情绪”的机器人。团队自述同时集成多项复杂技术非常困难，通过反复探索 SDK、头脑风暴与缩减范围寻找变通方案，并在黑客松期间仍遇到预期内的技术问题。
summary_en: In short: We gave a robot anxiety, and we made an XR experience where you try to calm it down! We transformed a K1 Booster humanoid robot—previously used for robot boxing and fighting—into an emotionally expressive being capable of simulated emotional sensation and expression . Through a combination of sensors, kinematic humanoid robot control, and conversational AI, we created real-world simulation scenarios for human users to practice de-escalation and compassionate conflict resolution. Integrating simultaneous complex technologies was fundamentally difficult. We approached this through iterative exploration of SDKs, brainstorming, de-scoping work with workarounds, but we encountered expected technical issues during the hack.

summary_en: Embodied Blocks is a modular toy that deepens a child's engagement with the physical world through sense-based reflection and storytelling. Children have the agency to manipulate building blocks, reconfiguring not just the toy’s form, but its physical intelligence as well. Through the addition of sensor blocks, the child gives the toy eyes, ears, a body that provides knowledge about the scenario being acted out as they interact with it in the real world to create a story. Our approach separates play from processing. After the toy is put down, it generates a story narration according to its inferred perception of it depending on its sensor capabilities. This is intentional to encourage reflection instead of interfering with active play: children gain the ability to learn from and share records about their creative, sensory exploration, and parents gain a window into their child’s world through their play information.

summary_en: JIRA is a physical AI cat companion built into a travel pillow. Its personality is modeled on real feline behavior and dynamically generated from live sensor data. Pet its head and it responds with warmth. Touch its tail and it gets annoyed. When it is genuinely happy, it purrs. The vibration motors deliver haptic feedback tuned to the 20 to 140 Hz range shown in research to lower cortisol and reduce blood pressure. The tail is a full emotional output channel. A tight grip during turbulence means something different than a light tap in calm air. The response shifts accordingly. JIRA can also hold a real conversation. Stuart keeps things organized, and builds connections between people who share a building or street but have never shared a conversation. Stuart allows us to share far more than just books. summary_en: Climbit is a handheld climbing controller that turns finger grip training into an AI-powered climbing adventure. The device is a dodecahedron-shaped handheld object designed to simulate the feeling of grabbing climbing holds. Pressure sensors placed between the holds detect where and how strongly the player grips the device. These inputs control a first-person climbing game in real time. As players move their fingers from hold to hold, they climb a virtual mountain of their choice. The system tracks grip timing, pressure, and movement patterns. When the player pauses or changes rhythm, the AI generates personalized events and short story missions, such as discovering hidden routes or encountering unexpected situations during the climb. By combining physical grip training with interactive storytelling, Climbit transforms repetitive finger exercises into a more engaging and immersive experience. We designed and fabricated a handheld device using 3D printing. The main body is a dodecahedron printed in PLA, while the climbing holds on the surface are printed in TPU to create a softer and more tactile grip. summary_en: Closer to the Fire is a handheld device disguised as a flip-top lighter. Here's the experience: Open the lid — The device speaks a reflective question aloud (e.g., "Are you missing anyone right now? Do you think they're missing you too?" ) Hold to record — Press and hold the button to record your spoken answer Hear a connection — The device finds and plays back a semantically similar answer from someone else who encountered the lighter before you Press again — Hear more anonymous answers to the same question Close the lid — Reset and receive a new question next time The lighter also functions as an actual lighter—it's a real object that belongs in the world. As the device travels through a community, it accumulates intimate reflections, building an anonymous tapestry of shared human experience. An e-ink display connected to the Pi showcased the dashboard of curiosities. The Pi and display were fitted in a custom 3D-printed case that served as the dock. summary: 这是一个手摇音乐盒装置。它读取皮肤电反应（GSR）与心率（HR）两路生理信号，归一化到0–1后以20个采样点的滑动窗口提取均值、标准差、斜率与峰值，形成四维特征序列；再用两个LSTM编码器-解码器分别学习GSR与HR的时序表征，把隐向量当作音乐控制信号：GSR塑形旋律，HR塑形速度与节奏。生成结果以MIDI写出并合成为约30秒音频。转动手柄即播放，停止转动即暂停。
summary_en: MEmento is a hand-cranked music box that transforms physiological signals linked to emotional arousal into a short musical composition. Input: two biosignals — galvanic skin response (GSR) and heart rate (HR) Output: a ~30s audio piece generated as MIDI and synthesized into sound Interaction: turn the handle to play; stop turning to pause Biosensing + preprocessing We read GSR (skin conductance) and HR, then cleaned and normalized both to a 0–1 range so they’re comparable. We extracted features with a sliding window (20 samples), computing: mean, standard deviation, slope, and peaks — producing a sequence of 4D feature vectors over time. Learning temporal patterns (LSTM encoder–decoder) We trained two LSTM encoder–decoder models (one for GSR, one for HR). Each encoder compresses the feature sequence into a latent vector capturing time-series dynamics (e.g., stability vs variability), and the decoder reconstructs signals to learn meaningful representations via reconstruction error. We use these latent values as musical control signals (GSR shaping melody, HR shaping tempo/rhythm). Music generation (MIDI → audio) The generator automatically selects two instruments from the full MIDI

summary_en: You hold the cube and speak a challenge. It could be a decision you're wrestling with, something you're trying to plan, a question you can't quite articulate yet. The cube listens. Then it maps your challenge to six distinct perspectives , one per face, each representing a different dimension of how humans naturally understand a problem: relevance, emotional resonance, relationships, blind spots, systemic forces, and what hasn't surfaced yet. You can rotate the cube to shift how these perspectives interact, just as turning a Rubik's Cube reconfigures its surrounding pieces. As you turn it, the embedded screens pulse with color, reflecting the evolving balance between perspectives. When you're ready, press a face to choose your primary lens. The cube responds with follow-up questions shaped not only by that one perspective, but by the full configuration you've created through rotation. summary_en: The experience follows a natural discovery loop ( Noticing → Identifying → Recording → Sharing → Collecting ), all driven by voice and your gaze. 1. Noticing. A Gemini Live voice agent runs the whole experience hands-free: raise an open palm toward your face and pinch to talk, and you are speaking to the system. A Naturalist agent guides you to slow down and observe through Socratic questions ("what do you notice about its wings?"), turning a passing glance into real attention. You can also ask the agent to scan for butterflies , which sweeps the camera view for a few seconds and flags any it finds. 2. Identifying. Once a butterfly is found, the agent kicks off species identification , then spawns a 3D info card filled with species data + photos, including its conservation status (a Secure-to-Critical gradient) so you understand how threatened it is. AI wing generation turns the identified species into a bespoke wing texture + opacity map applied to a live 3D butterfly that flutters into your space, while an Archivist agent shares facts, migration stories, and context. 3. Recording. Every sighting (species data, photos, and GPS) is persisted to the cloud via Supabase , gated by you

Interactive elements appear around the branches and canopy, creating a mixed-reality experience that blends physical craftsmanship with digital storytelling. The project demonstrates how physical models can serve as anchors for immersive educational experiences, museum exhibits, public art installations, and community storytelling projects. Rather than viewing AR as something that exists only on a screen, Tree XR encourages users to engage with digital content as part of the real world around them. We began with concept sketches to establish the visual direction of the tree, its characters, and the overall interactive experience. Those early drawings guided every part of the project, from structure to storytelling. Using Trippo AI, we translated our sketches into a 3D model of Pepper, our main character, and used AI tools to generate supporting assets such as the leaves, directly informed by our hand-drawn designs. summary_en: PokAR turns Spectacles into a hands-on Texas Hold'em coach with two distinct modes: Platform: Snap Spectacles and Lens Studio, written in TypeScript. Interaction: SpectaclesInteractionKit (pinch, grab, manipulate) and SpectaclesUIKit (buttons, switches) for fully hands-free, gesture-based controls: grabbable cards, drag-to-bet chips, and tactile action buttons. AI vision: Google Gemini (via the Remote Service Gateway) reads real-world cards from the camera feed and returns structured card data. Poker brain: a custom Monte Carlo HandEvaluator simulates win probability on-device from any set of hole and community cards. The same engine drives both the CPU opponent and the live win-% readout. Modes architecture: a shared GameManager enables exactly one mode at a time, with dedicated controllers for Single Player, Live/Real-World, and an in-progress Multiplayer layer (synced sessions, pot, and cards). summary_en: Matterly scans the objects around you to recognize what they are and what they're made of, whether you're holding something in your hand or looking across a room, no barcode or lookup needed. Reveals the object's hidden lifecycle, anchored to the real object in the space: where it came from (extraction, processing, manufacturing) and where it really goes (use, disposal), , staying honest about the fate most objects actually meet. Shows the real material cost in carbon and water, pulled from a citable materials database and research papers, not made up by the AI. Answers your questions through a voice AI sustainability advisor you can ask anytime. Compares multiple objects at the moment of purchase, weighing them across their full lifecycle, so you can make a better choice on the spot. Collects what you learn in a companion web portal, an object-dex where each scanned object unlocks its story, impact, and fate. We started with base learning block examples from Snap to get foundational tools in place such as DepthCache and AI Playground. We assembled what we needed from those and split the work across the team: UI/UX and interactions, AI pipelines and DB integration, and backend sync

summary_en: The Underlayer is a spatial learning experience for cybersecurity, built for Snap Spectacles. A chest-mounted ESP32 scanner detects nearby Wi-Fi and Bluetooth devices and streams what it finds to a backend relay. The backend identifies devices, checks operating system and package versions against vulnerability data, and generates AI-powered explanations and remediation guidance. summary: Dextra 是一款面向上肢功能障碍者的可穿戴机器人矫形器，目标是支撑康复训练与日常辅助使用。用户通过外接开关或手机 App 发出控制指令，ESP32 单片机解析信号后驱动 MG996R、TD-8135MG 等高扭矩舵机，舵机拉动以耐用线材构成的腱-滑轮机构，模拟人工肌腱牵引手指与腕部。输出动作为腕关节活动与稳定、手指屈伸，以及功能性三指捏握的抓取与释放。手套本体采用丁腈涂层针织手套以兼顾柔性、抓握与长时间佩戴。作者称已分析握力需求，但未给出数值；语音与 EMG 控制仍列为未来集成方向。
summary_en: Dextra is a smart wearable robotic orthosis that assists wrist and finger movement for patients with upper-limb impairments. The system uses servo-driven tendon actuation to mimic natural hand movement and provide controlled gripping and release actions. The device supports: Wrist articulation and stabilization Finger flexion and extension Functional 3-jaw chuck grip Switch-based control App-based control Future voice and EMG integration The orthosis is lightweight, portable, affordable, and designed for both rehabilitation and daily assistive use. The system was developed using an ESP32 microcontroller integrated with high-torque servo motors such as MG996R and TD-8135MG. A tendon-pulley mechanism using durable threads was designed to replicate artificial tendon movement for finger articulation. The glove structure was developed using comfortable nitrile-coated knitted gloves to ensure flexibility, grip, and long-duration usability. The complete workflow includes: User input through switch/app control Signal processing using ESP32 Servo motor actuation Tendon movement for finger and wrist articulation Assisted gripping and release movement We also analyzed grip-force requirements,

summary_en: TERRADRONE-SIM is a weather-aware survey-drone flight lab, mission planner, and 6-DOF physics simulator modeled around the DJI P4 Multispectral and FAA 14 CFR 107.51(c) regulations. It pulls hourly ensemble forecasts for a field's exact latitude and longitude using NVIDIA Earth-2 StormCast-CONUS (a 3 km high-resolution AI ensemble steered by NOAA GFS), standard NOAA GFS , or synthetic storm fronts. For every launch hour and ensemble scenario, the planner flies a custom-drawn survey grid using our point-mass simulator to evaluate flight time, battery consumption, pack count, and airframe stress. It then outputs an actionable CLEARED , CONDITIONAL , or NOT CLEARED verdict against 10 m/s gust limits, precipitation (>0.5 mm/h), FAA 3-statute-mile (4.8 km) visibility minimums, cold-weather battery derating, and emergency landings. Finally, it replays the selected launch window in a 500 Hz, 17-state rigid-body simulator to compare calm-air baselines against wind-perturbed trajectories, analyzing roll/pitch tilt, cross-track error, and individual rotor power draw. We architected TERRADRONE-SIM as a modular pipeline connecting Python-based AI weather ingestion with a zero-dependency browse

summary_en: DCSM-Simplified runs entirely on an Alif Ensemble E8 DevKit (Cortex-M55 + Ethos-U85 NPU). Point. A MobileNetV2 on the Ethos-U85 identifies the part in 7.9 ms . The LCD shows it with a confidence score and an info card. Labels are smoothed and gated, so an unsure model shows nothing instead of guessing. Say "yes" (or "go"). The part is held and an inspection checklist opens. "Yes" and "no" mark each item. A "no" on item 1 ("is this the right part?") rejects the identification, so the human corrects the model. Say "on" (or "go" or "right"). The device pages through specs, troubleshooting, LED codes and maintenance for that exact part. This is on-device retrieval keyed by what the camera saw, from a 15 KB knowledge base compiled into the firmware. There's no network, no cloud and no stored images. Visual intelligence: Uses OpenCV to process images and video, identify relevant objects, and detect potential obstacles. Adaptive navigation: Uses visual observations and environmental information to plan routes around obstacles. Swarm coordination: Models multiple drones navigating together while accounting for collisions, search coverage, and communication connectivity. Communication awareness: Monitors the simulated communication network and evaluates how movement affects connectivity to the base station. AWS integration: Supports cloud-based application deployment, mission-data storage, monitoring, and visualization. Quantum AI exploration: Investigates variational quantum circuits as a potential component of reinforcement learning, with classical baselines used to evaluate their effectiveness. Our objective is to create a system where visual observations can influence navigation decisions, rather than stopping at object detection alone. summary: CareMate 是一个在 MuJoCo 中运行的仿真护理机器人（PAL TIAGo++）取物项目。用户要它取某件物品时，它用头部相机看桌面并用 OpenCV 5 核对图像；若只是相似物，会说明匹配依据并拒绝，再依据未看区域的深度图换一个更好的视角；证据充分后，仅凭 OpenCV 轮廓与头部深度定位并抓取放到桌上，仍无法判断则保持手臂不动并说“无法确认，请协助”。感知结果只会是候选、模糊、未找到或错误，从不说“已确认”，每步都记入 trace.json；同一套感知还以 Web 服务形式跑在 AWS 上，可一键跑四帧机器人相机画面或上传自采画面。
summary_en: CareMate is a simulated care robot (PAL TIAGo++ in MuJoCo). Ask it for an item and it: looks at the table with its head camera and checks the image with OpenCV 5 ; if a look-alike explains the match, rejects it and drives to a better viewpoint chosen from a depth map of what it has not seen yet; once the evidence is clean, works out where the box is from the OpenCV outline and head depth only, picks it up and puts it on the resident's table; if it still cannot tell, keeps the arm still and says "Cannot verify, please help." Perception answers candidate / ambiguous / not_found / error , never "verified", and every step (view, reason, inliers, decision, collision checks) is logged to trace.json . The same perception runs as a web service on AWS (EC2 behind CloudFront, HTTPS). On the live page you can run four robot camera frames with one click (look-alike rejected, target accepted after moving, object absent), upload your own frame, or check whether a photo of a new item could be enrolled, with no retraining. OpenCV 5: ALIKED learned features ( cv2.ALIKED_create , ONNX run by OpenCV's DNN engine) on native-scale tiles inside a workspace ROI computed from the furniture map and camera

summary_en: "KisaanRakshak" combines environmental sensing, physiological monitoring, IoT connectivity, and AI-based risk assessment in a wearable system. "The prototype detects changes in pesticide-related airborne chemical/VOC exposure as an exposure-risk proxy." The device is designed to monitor: Chemical exposure: Detect changes in pesticide-related airborne chemical/VOC levels. Physiological parameters: Monitor heart rate, SpO₂, and body temperature. Exposure duration: Track how long the farmer remains in an elevated-exposure environment. Real-time risk: Combine these signals to estimate a dynamic risk level. Instant alerts: Trigger vibration/sound alerts when the estimated risk becomes high. Smart dashboard: Display live readings, risk score, exposure history, and safety recommendations. Instead of simply asking: “Is a chemical present?” KisaanRakshak aims to answer: “Is the current exposure potentially becoming unsafe for the farmer?” This shifts the system from simple detection toward preventive, personalized safety monitoring . "We plan to develop our prototype architecture is centered around an ESP32 microcontroller , which collects data from environmental and physiological sensors.

Frontend: Cross-platform React UI for Windows, featuring an intuitive dashboard with two main modes—Voice Generation and Voice Changing. summary_en: VESSEL is a speculative wellness tool — a lightweight wearable ring paired with a native iOS app — that makes your Empathic Reserve visible for the first time. It passively reads three biometric signals: your Heart Rate Variability (HRV), your Voice Warmth Index (vocal tone flattening), and your Somatic Movement patterns. These three signals are distilled into a single number — your Empathic Reserve Score from 0 to 100 — visualised as a glass jar that fills and empties in real time. When your reserve drops, VESSEL surfaces a gentle nudge before the breakdown — not after. It offers guided Refill Protocols (breathing exercises, body scans), tracks your weekly patterns to reveal your personal depletion triggers, and escalates compassionately when it detects multiple consecutive heavy days. Emergency resources are always one tap away. All data is processed on-device. No logging. No journaling. No extra steps. VESSEL was built as a fully interactive Figma Make prototype, designed to simulate a production-ready native iOS experience. summary_en: CaringU is a voice-first AI companion designed to help older adults stay safe while keeping their families connected. It demonstrates scam protection, QR-code risk detection, medication clarification, permission-based actions, controlled pharmacy payments, family alerts, weekly summaries, and photo sharing. CaringU combines AI with fixed safety rules. It uses Amazon Bedrock or NVIDIA Nemotron for agent reasoning, an MCP server to manage actions and confirmations, OpenCV for QR-code processing, Amazon Polly for voice responses, PayPal for permitted payments, and AWS infrastructure. Building CaringU reinforced that responsible AI is not only about generating helpful responses. It is also about controlling what happens next, handling uncertainty, and being transparent about limitations. Our guiding principle is simple: The AI talks. The rules decide. And the family is never far away.

summary_en: WALDO is an autonomous, voice-commanded pan/tilt searchlight turret that patrols your desk or room, spots people and objects, and tracks them with a focused beam of light. Tell it to "stop", "patrol", or nudge "left" / "right", and it snaps to attention. Ask it to track a "cup", "phone", or "bottle", and it locks on. Behind the scenes, WALDO runs two concurrent ExecuTorch neural networks entirely on a single Alif Ensemble E8 DevKit. No hidden laptops under the table, no AWS bills, and zero cloud latency. We designed WALDO around a "two brains in one chip" architecture, taking full advantage of the E8’s dual-core, dual-NPU silicon: The Always-On Ears (HE Core): The Cortex-M55 High-Efficiency core never sleeps. It captures audio from onboard microphones and routes it into the Arm Ethos-U55 NPU, running a fine-tuned MicroNet-M keyword spotter to listen for 10+ voice commands in real time. The High-Speed Eyes (HP Core): When duty calls, the 400 MHz Cortex-M55 High-Performance core spins up the Ethos-U85 NPU, running INT8-quantized YOLOv8n at a blistering 29 ms per frame on JPEG camera frames streamed over a 2 Mbaud UART link from an ESP32-S3 head. summary: CARE-Vision 维持一条感知—决策—动作闭环：轻量边缘网关采集视频、维护密集滚动缓冲、抽帧并执行感知指令；主视觉负载与确定性 Agentic Controller 运行在 AWS Graviton 上，基于 OpenCV 5 + COOL。视觉观测可促使控制器改请求不同传输速率、人物 ROI、全帧或近期缓冲证据；新证据被再次处理后，控制器继续观察、记录恢复，或发出需显式开启的测试告警。系统分别跟踪摄像头采集帧率与有效传输帧率。属黑客松原型，未披露准确率等指标。
summary_en: CARE-Vision maintains a perception–decision–action loop. A lightweight Edge Gateway captures video, maintains a dense rolling buffer, samples frames, and executes sensing commands. The main computer vision workload and a deterministic Agentic Controller run on AWS Graviton using OpenCV 5 + COOL. Visual observations can cause the controller to request a different transmission rate, a person region of interest, a full frame, or recent buffered evidence. New evidence is processed again before the controller continues observing, records recovery, or emits an explicitly enabled test alert. Camera capture rate and effective transmission rate are tracked separately. Camera/video → Edge sampling and buffer → AWS Graviton / OpenCV 5 + COOL → structured observation → agent decision → sensing command → new visual evidence

summary_en: FarmSage AI - Evidence-driven smart farming assistant using OpenCV computer vision and AI reasoning to analyze crop images, rank visual hypotheses,... FarmSage AI is a web application built with React and TypeScript. The computer-vision pipeline uses OpenCV-based image processing to extract measurable visual evidence from crop images. The reasoning layer combines the extracted evidence with crop type, growth stage, and field observations. The application also includes: Live field telemetry simulation Crop image comparison Crop field diary Diagnostic PDF reports Voice Agronomist English and Telugu support Evidence-based management recommendations Image-quality and uncertainty gates The application is maintained in a public GitHub repository with environment variables used for secrets instead of hard-coded API keys. We learned that a useful AI farming assistant should not simply predict a disease name. It should communicate evidence, uncertainty, alternative explanations, and the next action that a farmer can take. summary_en: BatteryGuard Vision analyzes an uploaded battery photograph using a combination of traditional computer vision and multimodal AI. The application: Checks resolution, sharpness, and lighting to identify photographs that may be unsuitable for inspection. Uses OpenCV 5 to identify candidate regions based on color, texture, and surface irregularities to highlight visual anomalies. Uses Amazon Bedrock's Nova Lite vision model to assess potential leakage-like residue, corrosion, casing damage, and deformation. Considers whether unusual visual features might be normal components, such as protective tape, labels, or battery seams. Explains potential findings, indicates uncertainty, and suggests additional evidence or human inspection when appropriate. Executes the OpenCV 5 image-analysis pipeline through AWS Lambda. Rather than assigning an arbitrary battery safety score, BatteryGuard Vision separates visual observations from confirmed defects, encouraging informed decisions and professional review.

We also built a network flashing service with a dashboard and per-job logs so teammates could deliver firmware builds to the shared board. Using electronic nose sensing technology, Aera analyzes subtle scent compounds released from the skin and translates them into a visual scent profile. The system then recommends fragrances that naturally harmonize with the user’s body chemistry. Instead of choosing perfumes through trial and error, Aera helps users understand how fragrances interact with their skin and discover scents that truly work for them. Aera was developed as a conceptual user experience prototype. We designed the interface using Figma, creating interactive flows that demonstrate how users would scan their scent chemistry, view their scent identity profile, and receive fragrance recommendations. The visual design draws inspiration from Art Nouveau aesthetics, particularly the flowing organic lines and botanical motifs found in the work of Alphonse Mucha. We combined this inspiration with a minimal interface to ensure the design felt elegant while still remaining clean and functional for a mobile application. summary: Presense 探索“让注意力可见”：系统设想在人的注意力从当下漂移时进行检测，并给出温和提醒，帮助用户回到当下，而不是强制专注。团队先访谈用户走神时的体感，把问题归结为注意力漂移时缺乏觉察。原文未披露具体传感输入、检测算法、提醒形态和效果验证，当前更接近概念与行为研究。
summary_en: Presence Sense explores the idea of making attention visible. The system detects when a person’s attention drifts away from the present moment and gently reminds them to come back. Instead of forcing focus it simply creates awareness. Our process began by trying to understand the behaviour itself. We spoke with people about moments when they realised they were not fully present. Almost everyone had experienced this in different ways: Some missed parts of conversations Some finished meals without noticing the taste Others felt their entire day had passed without clear memories This helped us recognize that: The problem was not distraction alone. The real issue was the lack of awareness when attention drifts.
